indexes_canonical_definition.name: idx_user_server
indexes_canonical_definition.rationale: Enforce one profile per (account, server). Primary lookup index.

indexes_canonical_definition.name: idx_user_active
indexes_canonical_definition.rationale: List active profiles for an account.

indexes_canonical_definition.name: idx_server_active
indexes_canonical_definition.rationale: List active profiles per server (capacity / load checks).

validator_strategy.behavior: read-only verification of the canonical indexes definition JSON; does NOT call create_index; does NOT touch DB
validator_strategy.contract: PASS if 3 indexes defined with consistent canonical naming and the unique constraint is on (user_id, server_id)

acceptance_criteria_for_indexes_apply_pa: create_index calls executed only via dedicated ops pack with explicit DB-write approval
Index creation must be idempotent (drop+recreate or skip-if-exists)
Post-apply validator verifies index existence on server_profiles collection
server_profiles collection itself is created in the same ops pack OR pre-existing
